atomicity.reason: One obligation: support MCS charging sessions.

feasibility.reason: MCS is available technology for 800 V trucks.

parent_fit.reason: MCS enables megawatt-level depot charging within a driver break (US_FAST_DEPOT_CHARGING).

unambiguity.reason: IEC 63379 primarily specifies the MCS vehicle coupler; whether the requirement also covers the session communication (ISO 15118-20 / IEC 61851-23-3) is open.
unambiguity.suggestion: Name the standards for both the coupler and the session communication.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated var.charging.mcs == True; MCS requires 800 V and exists only in BEV products, so it is stronger than the bev-gated parent.

verifiability.reason: 'Support charging sessions' gives no success condition beyond the standard reference (which session functions, which power class/current must be achieved).
verifiability.suggestion: State the verified scope, e.g. completes an MCS session to IEC 63379 / ISO 15118-20 at the rated current.
